title: Make New World the default theme every new Space starts in, with the first-selection picker

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail: New Spaces start on New World; the picker (LIVE-2043) lets them choose Kit, Accent, Register and Look first. Existing Spaces keep their theme. Never offered in a way that restyles a member or console area.
